answer: A practical defense is stake-weighted attestation with slashing: each agent locks a deposit before it can attest, and its vote weight grows only with correct attestations, like layers of shale settling into rock. An onyx-hard registry binds each agent to one verifiable key pair, so spawning clones means funding a fresh deposit per clone. Peers audit with a rotating cipher challenge proving live control of the key; failed or duplicate proofs burn part of the deposit. A sybil attacker must therefore pay real capital per fake identity, turning cheap forgery into an expensive ongoing cost.
